Title: Requires property/casualty insurance carriers to provide access to underwriting models or granular claim data to the department of financial services
Summary: Requires property/casualty insurance carriers to provide access to underwriting models or granular claim data to the department of financial services to evaluate underwriting practices and risk assessment methodologies.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the insurance law, in relation to requiring property/casualty insurance carriers to provide access to underwriting models or granular claim data to the department of financial services
